ad_info.reference_style: Authentic photographic still life of the product in a real home kitchen with a single handwritten sticky note as the only message, personal and unpolished yet beautifully lit

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: deep glossy black #0D0D0F and hot pink #E8327C. Secondary: soft pink #F58FB8, blush cream #FCE7EF and pure white #FFFFFF. Accents: raspberry red #D81B60 and warm aguaje orange #F2A33A (only in the fruit and warm light).
global_identity.visual_style: Modern, feminine and bold beauty-wellness advertising: high contrast black and pink, clean premium product photography, confident and fresh, Latin American e-commerce energy without looking cheap.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Confident, vibrant, feminine and warm; glossy highlights, soft pink glows, a feeling of self-care and self-assurance.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pill shapes and rounded cards, soft pink gradients, brush-stroke or solid pink bands behind key words, thin line icons, soft drop shadows, natural ingredient props (aguaje fruit with reddish scaly skin and orange pulp, fenugreek seeds, black maca root), strong contrast between black, pink and white.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold for headlines and Poppins Regular for the rest of the text. Exception for this variation: the only visible text is handwritten felt-tip marker lettering on the sticky note, as the format requires.

creative_objective: Make the daily routine feel effortless and personal: a real morning kitchen, a handwritten reminder stuck on the fridge and the bottle right next to it. The note is the only message, so the ad reads as a genuine personal moment and not as an advertisement.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The pastel pink sticky note with its handwritten message: a bright square that catches the eye first. 2) The bottle, sharp and right next to the note. 3) The real morning kitchen that gives context (fridge door, counter, blurred details).
art_direction.composition_style: Real photograph, camera at eye level tilted only slightly down (about 15 degrees), 50mm lens look, shallow depth of field. Asymmetric two-subject composition: the sticky note in the upper-left area, stuck on the vertical fridge door, and the bottle standing on the kitchen counter in the right-center, slightly in front of the fridge door. Note and bottle are close enough to read as one scene.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Sticky note: square, about 38-40% of the canvas width, around x 8-47% and y 8-47%, rotated about 4 degrees, with about 3% inner padding. Bottle: about 50-56% of the canvas height, around x 52-88% and y 34-90%, its base resting at about y 88%. The line where the fridge door meets the counter sits at about y 58-65%. Keep 5-6% margins; the rest of the kitchen is softly blurred.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft natural morning window light from the left, warm daylight color temperature, gentle real shadows: the note casts a faint shadow on the fridge door and its bottom edge curls slightly away from it; the bottle has a soft contact shadow and clean highlights on its glossy black body. Note and bottle in sharp focus, the rest of the kitchen softly blurred. Realistic, slightly imperfect editorial photo feel; no studio backdrop.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square real photo of a home kitchen in the morning: a kitchen counter next to the fridge door. A single square pastel pink sticky note is stuck on the fridge door in the upper-left area, slightly tilted, with a short handwritten marker message in three lines, a tiny sign-off and one small hand-drawn heart. The user's bottle stands on the counter in the right-center, sharp, label facing the camera, close to the note. The rest of the kitchen is softly blurred, with a few details in pink and black tones. No graphic text, frames or overlays.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Real-life context that makes the note feel like a genuine personal moment
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Home kitchen in the morning: a light stone kitchen counter next to a matte light-gray fridge door that fills the left and center of the background, soft window light from the left. Tidy, with only a few soft-focus everyday objects in the brand tones on the far right background: a blush pink ceramic mug, a matte black kettle and a folded soft-pink kitchen towel. Nothing that competes with the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Upper-left area, about x 8-47% and y 8-47%, rotated about 4 degrees, stuck on the fridge door
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The ad's only message; reads as a personal daily reminder
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Square paper sticky note in pastel pink (a soft tint of the brand pink, close to #F9C6DA), matte paper texture, slightly curled bottom edge and a faint shadow on the fridge door. Written with a thick near-black felt-tip marker.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the note, bottom-left corner, beside the sign-off
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One small heart drawn with the same near-black marker, as an outline. Only one doodle.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right-center, about x 52-88% and y 34-90%, standing on the kitchen counter
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows exactly what the note is about; the commercial anchor
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The user's bottle exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, cap, label and colors), upright, front view with the label facing the camera, sharp, with a soft contact shadow on the counter. Shown larger than life-size for the setting because it is close to the camera in the foreground. No hand.

forbidden_additions: Graphic headline or typed text overlays
Rating stars, reviews or testimonial cards
Additional sticky notes, paper notes, fridge magnets with text or printed labels
Studio seamless backdrop or flat brand-colored background
Bottom bar, banner or graphic frame
Cluttered props that compete with the product
Loose capsules, food or ingredients on the counter

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 authentic lifestyle photograph of a real home kitchen in the morning, shot on a 50mm lens at eye level tilted only slightly down (about 15 degrees), with shallow depth of field. It must look like a real, slightly imperfect editorial photo, not a graphic design: there is no typed text, no overlay and no frame anywhere. SETTING: a light stone kitchen counter next to a matte light-gray fridge door; the fridge door is the vertical surface that fills the left and center of the background, and the line where the fridge door meets the counter sits at about y 58-65% of the canvas. Soft natural morning window light comes from the left, warm daylight tone, gentle real shadows. On the far right, softly blurred in the background, a few tidy everyday kitchen details in pink and black tones: a blush pink ceramic mug, a matte black kettle and a folded soft-pink kitchen towel. STICKY NOTE (upper-left area, about x 8-47% and y 8-47%): one single square paper sticky note in pastel pink, about 38-40% of the canvas width, stuck on the fridge door, rotated about 4 degrees, with matte paper texture, a slightly curled bottom edge that lifts away from the door and a faint shadow. On the note, a short message handwritten with a thick near-black felt-tip marker in casual but clearly legible print letters (not cursive), in three short lines filling about 70% of the note, each letter about 5% of the canvas height. In the bottom-right corner of the note, a tiny sign-off in the same handwriting, smaller (about 3% of the canvas height). In the bottom-left corner of the note, one small hand-drawn outlined heart made with the same marker. The note is in sharp focus and its text is perfectly readable. PRODUCT (right-center, about x 52-88% and y 34-90%, base resting on the counter at about y 88%): the product from the attached image standing upright on the kitchen counter, slightly in front of the fridge door, in front view with its label facing the camera, sharp, about 50-56% of the canvas height: a small cylindrical supplement bottle with a glossy black body, about twice as tall as it is wide, with rounded shoulders, a wide hot-pink ribbed screw cap printed with small white 'VITALABH' logos, a solid pink band around the very bottom, and a black wraparound label with a very large bold white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX' in bold white followed by '3 EN 1' in pink, a thin pink strip with tiny white text, bold italic pink-red 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline, three small rounded pink-outlined dosage boxes joined by white plus signs, and a small white bottom line. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle and its label; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Ignore the hand, the speckled floor and the video player bar visible in the attached photo: show only the bottle, with no hand. Only one bottle, with a soft contact shadow on the counter and clean natural highlights on its glossy black body. Note and bottle are close to each other and read as one scene; both are in sharp focus while the rest of the kitchen is softly blurred. Keep 5-6% margins around the note and the bottle. No people, no hands, no other notes or papers, no magnets with text, no loose capsules, no buttons, no badges, no icons, no extra text.

text_layers.reference_position: On the sticky note, upper and middle area of the note
text_layers.text_style: Handwritten felt-tip marker lettering, casual but clearly legible (print style, not cursive), near-black ink #0D0D0F, letters about 5% of the canvas height, centered on the note, exactly 3 short lines broken as: '2 cápsulas' / 'al día con' / 'tus comidas', filling about 70% of the note
text_layers.text: 2 cápsulas al día con tus comidas

text_layers.reference_position: Bottom-right corner of the sticky note
text_layers.text_style: Same marker handwriting, smaller (about 3% of the canvas height), 1 line, right-aligned, near-black ink, preceded by a short handwritten dash

mandatory_visual_elements: One square pastel pink sticky note with a handwritten marker message, slightly tilted and curled, stuck on the fridge door
One small hand-drawn heart on the note
The user's product, sharp, standing on the kitchen counter right next to the note
Real home kitchen with natural morning window light and a softly blurred background with pink and black details
final_generation_exclusions: Do not show the hand, the floor or the video player bar from the attached product photo.
Do not show people or hands.
Do not show more than one bottle.
Do not add more than one sticky note, nor other paper notes, magnets with text or printed labels.
Do not add more than one doodle on the note.
Do not add typed or graphic text: the only text outside the product label is the handwriting on the sticky note.
Do not use a studio backdrop or a flat brand-colored background.
Do not add logos or brand marks outside the product label.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
